> **Figure 4.** Database and triage calls select 5,332 genes for the deep dive, which runs in three sequential stages, producing one validated record. (a) Every protein-coding gene is assessed by the five reference databases and, in parallel, by the two-stage triage agent. Proteins that only one database calls surface, and that the triage agent independently rates high-confidence non-surface with localization to a clear non-surface compartment (noted in the figure), are excluded; the rest of the union — 5,332 genes — goes forward to the deep dive. (b) The per-gene deep-dive pipeline runs in three sequential stages, producing one validated record. Stage 1, evidence retrieval: public databases build a candidate corpus, a per-paper Haiku 4.5 abstract triage selects papers worth fetching, open-access full text is recovered through a tiered fallback, and a Haiku 4.5 trim and Sonnet 4.6 selector yield per-protein evidence sets. Stage 2, block builders (Sonnet 4.6): builders draft the record's surface-evidence, surface-biology, and risk sections. Stage 3, synthesis (Sonnet 4.6): the synthesizer reads every section draft plus the Stage 1 evidence set, deterministic features, and the triage verdict, then writes the executive summary, structured filters, and confidence rationale.
<!-- END manuscript-legend -->

Two-panel figure: (a) how the 19,324 protein-coding genes are narrowed to
the 5,332-gene deep-dive cohort, and (b) the three-stage pipeline each of
those genes goes through.

- **Panel a** is generated by
  [`scripts/figures/pipeline_funnel.py`](https://github.com/Deliverome-Project/accessible-surfaceome/blob/main/scripts/figures/pipeline_funnel.py),
  which reads the numbers on the canvas from committed tables
  (`data/processed/figures/zero_db_rescues_by_triage.tsv`,
  `data/processed/figures/deep_dive_final_categories.tsv` and
  `data/processed/candidate_universe/candidate_universe_v3_dropped.tsv`).
- **Panel b** is an author-drawn diagram of the per-gene pipeline. Stage 1
  retrieves evidence: deterministic database and literature search, then a
  Haiku 4.5 abstract triage, a Haiku 4.5 trim and a Sonnet 4.6 selector.
  Stage 2 runs nine Sonnet 4.6 block builders (most in parallel; evidence
  grading and risks run after them). Stage 3 is the Sonnet 4.6 synthesizer.
  At the Sonnet 4.6 tier a gene costs a median of $1.34 and takes about
  9 minutes of wall-clock time.
- [`scripts/figures/compose_deep_dive_figure.py`](https://github.com/Deliverome-Project/accessible-surfaceome/blob/main/scripts/figures/compose_deep_dive_figure.py)
  stacks the two panels into `deep_dive_flow.svg` (bundled here), plus a PDF
  and a PNG in the repo.
